info.title: API.SH: Bitbucket
info.description: The Bitbucket API from API.SH: public Bitbucket data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Branches of a repository with their latest commit (hash, date, message, author) and default merge strategy. Filter by name and sort by name or commit date. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bitbucket-branches

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as workspace/repo, or a bitbucket.org link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only branches whose name contains this.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as workspace/repo, or a bitbucket.org link.

parameters.name: hash

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Commits of a repository, newest first, optionally on one branch, tag or commit and touching one path: hash, date, message, author name and account, parents. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bitbucket-commits

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as workspace/repo, or a bitbucket.org link.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: Branch, tag or commit to list from (default: all branches).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Only commits touching this file or folder.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 30).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bitbucket-pull-requests

get.description:
The public repositories of a workspace with description, language, size, main branch, project, dates and clone links. Filter by name, language or project; sort by update, creation, name or size. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bitbucket-repositories

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: Workspace id (the first part of a bitbucket.org link) or a link.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only repositories whose name contains this.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Only this language, e.g. java or python.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: Only this project key (from `/bitbucket/v1/workspace`).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default -updated_on).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

parameters.name: repo

get.description:
The file tree of a repository at a branch, tag or commit: a folder lists its files and subfolders (path, type, size, MIME type); a file returns its text content (up to 500 KB) and a raw link. For long folders pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bitbucket-source

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository as workspace/repo, or a bitbucket.org link.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag or commit (default: the main branch).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder or file path (default: the root folder).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page of a folder listing.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
